title: Hearty Charred Canadian Salmon Wrap
description: A Whole30-friendly, date-night Canadian dish featuring charred salmon, turmeric, and a lotus leaf wrap, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, mix together turmeric powder, salt, and black pepper
Rub the spice mixture evenly over both sides of the salmon fillets
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Sear the salmon fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer to a baking sheet
Bake the salmon in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through
While the salmon is cooking, poach the dates in a saucepan of boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and set aside
To assemble the wraps, lay a lotus leaf flat on a work surface and place a cooked salmon fillet in the center
Top the salmon with a poached date, a sprinkle of chopped parsley, and a squeeze of lemon juice
Fold the lotus leaf over the filling to form a wrap, and serve immediately
